messages:
Aisha: Quick shout — huge thanks to @Priya and @Sam from Data Platform for patching the CSV ingest last night. Our demo would've died without that fix. :tada:
Tom: Wow, heard about that. Amazing quick turnaround. coffee/beer next time? :coffee:
Priya: Happy to help! Sam spotted the edge case in the schema and I pushed a tiny hotfix. Glad it helped.
Sam: Yea — beat me out by 3 mins. also added a short note to the migration doc: https://redwood.infra/docs/migrations#csv-ingest
Jen: You two are heroes. Dropping cookies in the kitchen around 3pm so come by :cookie:
Aisha: Sending an official kudos — @kudos-bot can you drop a token for Priya + Sam? :heart:
kudos-bot: Awarded 2 kudos points to Priya and 2 kudos points to Sam. Nice work! :sparkles:
Tom: Also, re: demo follow-up — if anyone wants to pair on a more resilient ingest step, I'm free after stand.
Priya: count me in. Sam? 
Sam: Yup. Let's sync 11:30. Thanks again everyone :raised_hands:
Jen: Photo of the cookie stash when it's out and I will caption it "tiny heroes tiny cookies" :camera:
Aisha: Love it. Endangered demo averted. :relieved:
